categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Lanyu Digital Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of digital inkjet printing inks, focusing on water-based digital textile inks including disperse, reactive, acid, and pigment inks. The company also operates subsidiaries involved in digital textile printing services, industrial park management, garment accessories manufacturing, and digital label printing equipment manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced digital inkjet printing technology integrating computer control, mechatronics, precision machinery, and fine chemical processes. Key production methods include nano-grinding, desalination nanofiltration, and emulsification for stable water-based inks. The company emphasizes proprietary formulations optimized for compatibility with major industrial printheads (Epson, Kyocera, Seiko, Ricoh, etc.) and has developed over 3,000 ink formulas with 19 patents, including 10 invention patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include digital textile printing equipment manufacturers, textile printing and dyeing enterprises, and trade service providers. The end markets are mainly textile and apparel printing, with applications in polyester, cotton, silk, nylon, acrylic, and blended fabrics. The company also serves digital printing markets for paper products and digital label printing through its subsidiaries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, headquartered in Yiwu, Zhejiang Province, a major textile and small commodities hub. It has expanded overseas with subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Singapore, the United States, Indonesia, and India, focusing on trade and investment activities. Domestic sales account for approximately 68% of revenue, with international sales making up about 32%. Key export markets include Asia, Europe, and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Lanyu Digital Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the digital textile printing supply chain, producing critical consumables—digital textile inks—that are used in conjunction with upstream printheads and printing equipment and downstream textile printing services. It also has downstream operations through subsidiaries providing printing services and equipment manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation to reduce ink costs, improve product quality, and support green and digital transformation in textile printing. R&D focuses on optimizing ink formulations for high precision, stability, and compatibility with evolving printheads, developing high-temperature and high-fastness inks, and automating raw material processing. It maintains strategic partnerships with Epson and other printhead manufacturers and invests in expanding production capacity and R&D infrastructure.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of digital textile inks and related consumables. The company employs both direct sales to end customers and digital printing equipment manufacturers, as well as sales through trade service providers who bundle inks with equipment and provide technical support. Additional revenue streams include digital textile printing services and sales of digital label printing equipment and inks via subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading domestic producers of digital textile inks in China, recognized as a national high-tech and specialized 'little giant' enterprise. It competes with imported ink brands and other domestic ink manufacturers, leveraging its technological innovation, product quality certifications (OEKO-TEX® ECO PASSPORT, Bluesign®), and strategic partnerships with major printhead suppliers. It holds a strong market position with a broad product portfolio covering multiple ink types.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 478.46 million, a 24.72% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 100.51 million, up 8.44%. Total assets exceeded RMB 1.07 billion, more than doubling from the previous year, reflecting rapid growth and capital expansion, including a successful IPO raising over RMB 416 million. The company maintains a healthy gross margin around 37% and continues to increase R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Lanyu Digital Technology emphasizes high-quality, environmentally friendly digital textile inks with stable performance, excellent color saturation, and compatibility with a wide range of industrial printheads. Its inks meet stringent safety and environmental standards, reducing reliance on imported products and lowering customer costs. The company’s integrated R&D and production capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and close collaboration with equipment manufacturers provide differentiated technological advantages and strong customer loyalty.
